dogecoin.text:
2014: Sure Dogecoin is silly, but it's so much fun.

2021: Sure Dogecoin is silly, but I'm so so so much fun.

You're using Dogecoin to pump all digital assets together in the same bucket. That's like equating all stocks with that NJ Deli. 

All markets have their excesses. And the genius of the market is that over time, those who are wrong go broke...
